title: Raaz
desc: A large mansion situated in Nairobi, resounds with the shrieks of its owner Kumar - a young man of Indian origin. Night after night he is woken up by three dreams - a woeful melody of a damsel in distress.

title: Khubsoorat
desc: The lady of a household runs the place with utmost strictness but hilarity and chaos ensues when her daughter-in-law's younger sister pays a visit and tries to change the rules in the house.

title: Tyagi
desc: Shankar takes the blame when one of his brothers is accused of a murder. However, when he returns from jail, he realises that his brothers are trying to create a rift in the family.

title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.
